description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and macros for pitch period detection in AMR speech codec, including initialization, reset, exit, and main pitch calculation functions.

classes.name: Pitch_frState
classes.description: Structure holding previous subframe pitch lag information.

methods.name: Pitch_fr_reset
methods.description: Resets the pitch_fr state structure to zero.

methods.name: Pitch_fr_exit
methods.description: De-initializes and frees the pitch_fr state structure.

methods.name: Pitch_fr
methods.description: Calculates the pitch period for a subframe, with parameters for mode, excitation, target vector, impulse response, and other parameters.
